_comment_cookies: Netscape cookies.txt exported from a signed-in browser. Optional, but YouTube blocks anonymous bulk downloads quickly. NEVER commit this file.
_comment_js_runtime: Directory containing a Deno binary. YouTube serves a JS challenge yt-dlp must execute; without a runtime on PATH every download fails on signature extraction.
_comment_download: Tuned against YouTube, not against your machine. 4 workers with a 3s delay is the ceiling before YouTube starts returning fake 'unavailable' for good videos - raising these yields LESS data, not more.
